request.style: English, tender piano ballad, pure gentle female vocal, piano, cello, string ensemble, soft choir pads in the last chorus, reflective and adoring, 68 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In Nazareth the angel came to a girl pledged to be wed
Greetings, you who are favored, the Lord is with you, he said
She was troubled at his words, but he told her not to be afraid
She would bear the Son of the Most High, whose kingdom will not fade

[Pre-Chorus]
I am the Lord's servant
May it be to me according to your word

[Chorus]
My soul magnifies the Lord
And my spirit rejoices in God my Savior
For he has looked upon the humble state of his servant
Holy is his name

[Verse]
In Bethlehem she laid her son down in a manger bed
The shepherds came and told the word that the angel said
Mary treasured up all these things
And pondered them in her heart

[Chorus]
My soul magnifies the Lord
And my spirit rejoices in God my Savior
For he has looked upon the humble state of his servant
Holy is his name

[Verse]
Years later by the cross of Jesus, there his mother stood
With the disciple whom he loved, beneath the cruel wood
Woman, here is your son
Here is your mother

[Bridge]
His mercy extends to those who fear him
From generation to generation
He has brought down rulers from their thrones
And lifted up the humble

[Chorus]
My soul magnifies the Lord
And my spirit rejoices in God my Savior
For he has looked upon the humble state of his servant
Holy is his name

[Outro]
Holy is his name
